1221200fcc3884b8.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال تخصصه، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل رعاية للمرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لجمع المعلومات اللازمة. دراسة الحالة المرضية بدقة وإجراء الفحص السريري اللازم لتحديد طبيعة المشكلة. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير بدقة لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية بشكل دوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. تفاصيل العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. بيئة العمل ستعمل ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان، حيث يتم التركيز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى في بيئة داعمة ومهنية. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو الأطباء المتخصصين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة المهنية في الهفوف.

12dab2109fe152db.job_title: HVAC Technician Golf Villas & Resort Residences Four Seasons Resort Red Sea
12dab2109fe152db.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
12dab2109fe152db.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an HVAC Technician for the pre-opening Engineering team at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea. This full-time position is based in Umluj and Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring optimal comfort and system reliability across the Golf Villas and Resort Residences. Role Overview The HVAC Technician will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems. This role is critical for maintaining air quality and system performance within all residential and support areas, working closely with the Engineering team to provide proactive maintenance and efficient response to system issues. Key Responsibilities Install, inspect, maintain, and repair HVAC systems within Golf Villas and Resort Residences. Conduct routine preventive maintenance on air conditioning, ventilation, and cooling systems. Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC system faults, ensuring timely repairs. Monitor system performance to ensure optimal temperature, humidity, and air quality levels. Ensure all HVAC systems operate efficiently and comply with safety and environmental standards. Support the maintenance of chillers, AHUs, FCUs, split units, and central plant systems. Respond promptly to service requests and emergency breakdowns. Maintain accurate records of maintenance work, inspections, and repairs. Coordinate with Engineering team members for planned maintenance activities. Ensure tools, equipment, and work areas are kept clean, safe, and well maintained. Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures at all times. Area of Responsibility The primary areas of responsibility include the Golf Villas, Resort Residences, and associated Engineering and mechanical plant areas throughout the resort. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in HVAC system installation, maintenance, and repair. The role requires technical expertise to contribute to guest comfort and residential living standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the pre-opening Engineering team at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea, located in Umluj and Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia.

12ed3b58675e67bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمكان الطبية عن مشرف موقع إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية لضمان تطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات بشكل فعال. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مدى التزام مواقع الإنشاءات بالقواعد واللوائح المعمول بها. الإبلاغ عن أي مخالفات وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في المواقع الإنشائية لضمان فعاليتها. مراجعة المخططات الأولية والخطط الخاصة بمشاريع الإنشاءات. إصدار تراخيص للمضي قدماً في الأعمال الإنشائية في حال التأكد من الالتزام بالمتطلبات. فحص النظم المختلفة مثل أجهزة الرفع والنقل والممرات الجانبية المتحركة، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المطلوبة. تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية. فهم عميق للقواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. القدرة على تحديد المخالفات واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في المراقبة والتفتيش. القدرة على قراءة ومراجعة المخططات والخطط الهندسية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع الإنشاءات. مهارات تواصل فعالة للإبلاغ عن المخالفات ومتابعة الإجراءات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة في المشاريع الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

1201ad48f1eb97c5.description: About the Role INARCO-MEP is seeking an MEP Procurement Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the procurement of essential materials and equipment for the company's projects, ensuring optimal quality, pricing, and timely delivery in alignment with project specifications. Role Overview The MEP Procurement Officer is responsible for overseeing the entire procurement lifecycle for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, firefighting, and low-current materials and equipment. This includes supplier management, negotiation, order placement, and coordination to prevent project delays and material shortages. Key Responsibilities Receive and review material requisitions, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and technical specifications from project and engineering teams. Identify, evaluate, and maintain a database of approved local and international suppliers and manufacturers. Issue Requests for Quotation (RFQ), prepare comparative bid analyses, and recommend suitable suppliers. Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and warranties to achieve cost savings. Prepare and issue purchase orders and subcontract orders in line with approved submittals and Material Approval Requests (MARs). Ensure procured items comply with approved materials, SASO/SBC requirements, and project specifications. Follow up with suppliers on production, shipping, customs clearance, and on-site delivery. Coordinate with site teams, engineers, and the warehouse to avoid delays and material shortages. Track orders, delivery status, and pending items using procurement trackers or ERP systems. Verify supplier invoices, delivery notes, and goods receipt, and coordinate with accounts for payment processing. Handle discrepancies, damaged or rejected materials, returns, and warranty claims. Monitor market price trends and support cost control efforts against project budgets. Maintain complete procurement records and ensure compliance with company policies. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in MEP procurement or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage procurement processes for complex projects. Strong negotiation and supplier management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic project-driven environment. The role requires close collaboration with various internal teams and external suppliers to ensure project success.

لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة الخدمات المشتركة أو الإدارة العامة. فهم عميق للسياسات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالخدمات الإدارية والصيانة والأمن. قدرة مثبتة على قيادة الفرق وتوجيهها نحو تحقيق الأهداف. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة متعددة المهام. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل مدير الخدمات المشتركة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق مستويات عالية من الكفاءة في جميع العمليات. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة وتتطلع إلى فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة مجموعة المجال العربي، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

12cd0ede613072ff.job_title: Technician Commercial Vehicles Al Futtaim Automotive FAMCO

This full-time role involves performing preventive maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on commercial vehicles, ensuring adherence to manufacturer standards and company procedures. The successful candidate will contribute to maximizing vehicle uptime and delivering high-quality service. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive maintenance, breakdown repairs, and running repairs on commercial vehicles. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and powertrain-related issues. Execute repairs involving clutch systems, brakes, aggregates, and other vehicle components. Ensure repairs are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with OEM standards. Identify additional repair opportunities and provide technical observations to improve vehicle performance. Utilize diagnostic tools, workshop equipment, and special service tools safely and effectively. Maintain accurate technical reports and identify root causes of vehicle concerns. Follow workshop safety standards, ISO requirements, and company procedures. Support and guide junior technicians to ensure quality workmanship and adherence to repair standards. Ability to work independently and efficiently under pressure. Strong communication and technical reporting skills. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering excellent service. Continuous learning attitude and willingness to develop technical capabilities. Strong safety awareness and adherence to workshop standards and procedures. Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Al-Futtaim Automotive FAMCO service team. The role requires adherence to workshop safety standards and participation in ongoing technical training.

126b29103d89ca92.description: نبحث عن مشرف مطعم يتمتع بمهارات قيادية قوية وشغف بخدمة العملاء لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وتقديم تجربة استثنائية لضيوفنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إدارة فريق العمل، والإشراف على جودة الطعام والخدمة، وضمان الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة. إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة اللازمة والقدرة على تحفيز فريقك لتحقيق أهداف المطعم، ندعوك للانضمام إلينا. المهام والمسؤوليات: * قيادة وتوجيه فريق العمل لتحقيق أعلى مستويات الأداء. * ضمان تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وودودة. * مراقبة جودة الطعام والمشروبات والتأكد من مطابقتها للمعايير. * إدارة المخزون وطلب المواد اللازمة. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المطعم وفقاً للمعايير الصحية. * حل شكاوى العملاء بفعالية واحترافية. * تدريب الموظفين الجدد وتطوير مهارات الفريق الحالي. * اجراء الجرد الدوري ومتابعة العهد والاصول التشغيلية * التاكد من الالتزام بالسياسات والاجراءات والاستراطات الصحية المعتمدة

12fbfb1167def84f.description: We’re Hiring: Service Advisor 360 Car Maintenance | Saudi Arabia Location: Khobar Branch 360 Car Maintenance is looking for a customer-focused Service Advisor to manage the customer journey from vehicle reception to delivery. The ideal candidate combines automotive knowledge, clear communication, and strong coordination skills. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, understand their concerns, and accurately record service requests. Open job cards and document vehicle details, mileage, condition, and customer requirements. Coordinate with technicians to explain inspection findings and recommended repairs. Prepare quotations, explain costs and estimated completion times, and obtain customer approval before work begins. Coordinate with the workshop, spare parts team, and cashier to keep jobs progressing. Update customers on repair status, additional findings, and any changes to cost or delivery time. Confirm quality checks are completed before vehicle handover. Explain completed work, invoices, warranty terms, and maintenance recommendations. Follow up after service, handle concerns professionally, and maintain accurate records in the workshop system. Achieve agreed service sales and customer satisfaction targets through suitable recommendations. Requirements Previous experience as a Service Advisor in an automotive workshop or dealership. Good understanding of vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, and repair services. Strong customer service, communication, and organizational skills. Ability to explain technical issues in simple language. Confidence using workshop management systems and basic computer applications. Arabic and English communication skills are preferred. Experience with American vehicles is an advantage.

127143ab820575c0.description: مطلوب مهندس مبيعات ميداني – شركة سواعد الأفكار للمقاولات تعلن شركة سواعد الأفكار للمقاولات في ينبع عن حاجتها إلى مهندس مبيعات لتسويق خدمات التشغيل والصيانة وجلب عقود جديدة . المهام : استقطاب العملاء من الأفراد وملاك العمائر والمحلات والمكاتب . تسويق عقود الصيانة الشهرية والسنوية . تنفيذ زيارات ميدانية وتقديم عروض الأسعار ومتابعتها . بناء علاقات مع شركات إدارة الأملاك والمنشآت التجارية . إعداد تقرير أسبوعي بالزيارات والعملاء والعقود المحققة . التنسيق مع فريق العمل لإدارة وتنفيذ العقود الشروط : خبرة في المبيعات الميدانية، ويفضل في المقاولات أو الصيانة . مهارات تفاوض وإقناع وتواصل جيدة . معرفة بمدينة ينبع والقدرة على العمل الميداني . الالتزام بتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية . المزايا : راتب وعمولات تُحدد حسب الخبرة ونظام العمل، مع حوافز مرتبطة بالنتائج .

12443ee4557a5b9f.description: نبحث عن بائع عطور محترف للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، حيث ستكون مسؤولاً عن تقديم الاستشارات المتخصصة للعملاء لاختيار العطور المناسبة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المطلوبة. المهام تشمل: عرض وتسويق مجموعة متنوعة من العطور الرجالية والنسائية، تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة وبناء علاقات طويلة المدى مع الزبائن، إدارة المخزون وتنظيم العرض بطريقة جذابة، ومتابعة آخر صيحات عالم العطور لتقديم المشورة الصحيحة. المرشح المثالي يجب أن يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وخبرة سابقة في مجال المبيعات أو التجميل، مع القدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة وتحقيق النتائج المرجوة.

1262de2479ae15b5.description: About the Role Savills is seeking an HR Generalist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role provides comprehensive HR operational support to the Savills KSA business, encompassing day-to-day HR delivery, support for the HR team, and ad-hoc project work. The HR Generalist will also provide operational and transactional HR services support for the Head of KSA, taking ownership of employee relations casework and managing processes independently with support from the Head of HR in KSA and the wider regional team. Key Responsibilities Engage with staff, managers, and stakeholders on operational HR matters, supporting the local HR Strategy, ER, L&D, Performance Management, and Employee Engagement initiatives. Promote the Savills brand and support initiatives to enhance the Employer Proposition and Global Branding. Lead local recruitment activities in conjunction with the regional Talent Acquisition team, including CV screening, interviews, and selection processes. Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for KSA, utilizing company software and recruitment portals. Develop the Graduates program for KSA and represent Savills at Saudi universities. Train and coach hiring managers on the recruitment cycle and talent acquisition processes. Provide recruitment KPIs and tracking to the Head of HR and Regional HR team as requested. Implement tools and professional practices to improve HR processes and reporting. Review and enhance joiner and leaver processes, utilizing HR analytics for management reporting. Collaborate with Marketing, IT, Compliance, and Finance teams on HR projects and initiatives. Manage the development and delivery of the staff induction program. Ensure proper implementation of performance management processes during probationary periods. Assist in the delivery and planning of training arrangements and support e-learning provisions. Work on ad-hoc HR projects and operational improvement tasks. Act as a point of contact for employee relations matters, addressing concerns and resolving conflicts. Assist with reporting and analytics for plc, local country, or regional levels. Conduct investigations into employee complaints and grievances, ensuring confidentiality. Escalate complex employee relations issues to the Head of HR and assist with cases. Advise managers on probationary reviews and contract renewal. Assist with annual appraisal and promotion processes. Liaise with the Training Development Manager and Head of HR to identify employee training needs. Manage the full operational visa process for new joiners, renewals, and leavers. Work with managers to ensure a smooth onboarding process and assist with induction. Collaborate with the Head of HR on improving onboarding and offboarding processes. Ensure integrity and accuracy of data on internal systems and improve team use of systems. Follow up with GRO regarding licenses, portals, regulations, medical insurance, and other insurance matters. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Proven experience as an HR Generalist in KSA, with a minimum of 3-5 years. In-depth knowledge of KSA labor laws and regulations. Proficiency in HRIS and Microsoft Office Suite, with ideal proficiency in an ERP such as MS Dynamics. CIPD certification is considered a plus. Required Skills Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information discreetly. High attention to detail and strong execution skills. Ability to plan and prioritize work and conflicting demands. Good understanding of the pace and urgency related to the HR function. Solid MS Outlook and Word experience. Good Excel experience, including basic formulas and formatting. Proficient at navigating technology and capable of learning systems quickly and independently. Articulate, proactive, professional, and confident demeanor; able to work with minimal supervision. Eager to learn and grow within a fast-paced and dynamic team structure. Good planning and organizational skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in our Riyadh office, supporting the Savills KSA business. Application Process Candidates meeting the requirements are encouraged to apply.

12ad60dd4cc1fc11.description: About AnchorGF AnchorGF is seeking a dedicated Accountant to join its team in Al Khobar. This position supports the management team by providing timely and precise financial information for decision-making and strategic planning. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain comprehensive financial records. Prepare and present financial reports accurately and on schedule. Record daily financial transactions and ensure their proper classification. Reconcile bank accounts regularly to ensure accuracy. Monitor expenses and revenues to track financial performance. Ensure strict compliance with all applicable accounting policies and regulations. Support budgeting processes and contribute to financial analysis. Assist with tax and VAT reporting requirements. Demonstrated ability to manage financial records and prepare reports. Strong understanding of accounting principles and regulations. 12601dbf0e4332a4.description: Eram Talent, a leading Talent Acquisition Company, is seeking a qualified and experienced HV Technician - Electrical to join a prestigious company in the industry. As a HV Technician, you will be responsible for working with high voltage electrical systems, ensuring that maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs are conducted safely and efficiently. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to important projects and be part of a team of skilled professionals. If selected, this opportunity would be onsite at Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Install, maintain, and repair high voltage electrical equipment and systems. Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on electrical systems to enhance reliability and performance. Troubleshoot electrical faults and provide effective solutions to restore system functionality. Ensure compliance with safety regulations and standards while working on high voltage systems. Coordinate with other team members and departments to minimize downtime during maintenance activities. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment status, and inspection reports. Stay updated with advancements in high voltage technology and industry best practices. Participate in safety training and promote a culture of safety in the workplace. Technical diploma or certification in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience working with high voltage electrical systems. Strong knowledge of electrical safety protocols and high voltage regulations. Experience with the installation and maintenance of substations, transformers, and switchgears. Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to interpret electrical schematics. Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety standards. Good communication and organizational skills. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Willingness to work in various conditions and on-call as required.

12a1243df693652a.description: About the Future Talent Programme Tetra Pak is seeking highly motivated recent graduates to join its Future Talent Programme as a Services Sales Analyst. This trainee programme offers a permanent position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with an onboarding date in September 2026. Participants will engage in an individually designed 18-month development program, connected to specific projects and the Tetra Pak organization, including trainings and job rotations across various parts of the company. Role Overview: Services Sales Analyst As a Services Sales Analyst Trainee, you will gain exposure to Tetra Pak's business operations and collaborate with international colleagues. This role focuses on supporting the Services Director and Services Sales team in strategic planning, forecasting, and performance analysis. The position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, providing a foundation for a career within Tetra Pak. Key Responsibilities Support the Services Director and Services Sales team in preparing the Services sales strategy, including analyzing sales opportunities using internal data sources such as Services Sales Pipeline, CRM (Salesforce), and Power BI reports. Assist with Services Sales Forecasting by utilizing historical data and market/opportunities analysis (Services Sales Pipeline, CRM, Power BI reports) to identify future sales potential. Create reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to the team and management. Perform market analysis, applying knowledge of market conditions, competitors, and Services categories to provide actionable insights. Monitor overall Services sales performance using CRM (Salesforce) and guide Services Leads and Opportunities within CRM. Collaborate with the Services sales team (SKAMs, Services Sales Managers, and Inside Sales Managers) and other stakeholders. The company fosters a culture that values innovation, with industry experts driving results. This position provides an equal opportunity employment experience that prioritizes diversity and inclusion, alongside market-competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements. Work Location This is an internship position based at Tetra Pak's site in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

123a9ab05af7862d.description: About Gilead Sciences and Kite Gilead Sciences, Inc. is dedicated to improving global health through the development of therapies for diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19, and cancer. Kite, a biopharmaceutical company within Gilead, specializes in developing innovative cancer immunotherapies, specifically chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and T cell receptor (TCR) engineered cell therapies. These therapies reengineer a patient’s own immune cells to combat cancer. The company operates in a dynamic and innovative environment, with multiple planned launches and evolving competitive landscapes globally. The Role of Cell Therapy Account Manager The Cell Therapy Account Manager (CTAM) serves as the primary point of contact for Kite’s Authorized Treatment Centers (ATCs) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, field-based role involves developing and maintaining relationships with ATCs, ensuring a seamless customer experience, and driving the appropriate utilization of Kite’s CAR T therapies within these accounts. The CTAM will cultivate strong relationships with account stakeholders, coordinate all Kite activities, and communicate the value of CAR T therapy to key decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Kite’s relationship with assigned ATCs, including building account profiles and fostering business relationships with senior leadership, Thought Leaders (TLs), and other key stakeholders. Serve as the primary contact for ATCs, collaborating with cross-functional Kite colleagues (*, Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Quality) to address stakeholder needs and develop solutions. Manage day-to-day operations within accounts, coordinating activities such as site qualification, site setup, and patient treatment, and ensuring compliance-related activities like periodic audits. Provide clinical instruction to clinical staff, including guidance on AE Management and Product Inserts (PI), and oversee activities in patient treatment areas to ensure Chain of Identity (COI) per SOP protocols. Drive appropriate utilization of Kite’s therapies by assessing performance, developing strategic account plans, and educating key ATC stakeholders on product use, approved messaging, and clinical data in collaboration with Marketing and Medical Affairs. Maintain clinical expertise in Hematology, Immunology, Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma disease and treatment, and Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation. Support Kite’s strategic activities in Saudi Arabia by providing feedback and insights from HCP interactions to Medical Affairs, assisting at professional meetings, and facilitating timely feedback to management regarding business trends and opportunities. Cultivate relationships and participate in grassroots advocacy/engagement activities within the territory to align with regional and national initiatives. Operate in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and policies governing Kite activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Cell Therapy Account Manager position should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires a strong understanding of the healthcare landscape and the ability to build and maintain professional relationships with diverse stakeholders within Authorized Treatment Centers. Work Environment This is a full-time, field-based position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working directly with Kite’s Authorized Treatment Centers and requires adherence to all governing laws, regulations, and company policies. Application Process Gilead Sciences is seeking passionate and ambitious individuals ready to make a direct impact in the field of cell therapy. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

123dd2387efb6d51.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking an experienced Heavy Equipment Operator – Sideboom for a full-time, on-site position in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. This role is critical for pipeline construction operations, involving the lifting, carrying, holding, and lowering of pipe along the right-of-way. The operator will support stringing, welding, coating, and lowering-in fronts, contributing to spread progress while maintaining strict lifting safety standards. Key Responsibilities Operating the sideboom in strict adherence to the manufacturer's load chart and approved lift plans. Holding pipe in precise alignment for the welding front, ensuring no shock loading occurs. Executing coordinated multi-machine lifts to lower welded strings into the trench. Completing documented pre-use inspections each shift and promptly reporting any defects. Assessing ground bearing capacity and stability before positioning equipment. Working effectively with signals from the designated rigger, under the supervision of the Pipeline Foreman and Lifting Supervisor. Qualifications and Experience A strong background in pipeline construction operations, including stringing, welding support, lowering-in, tie-ins, and crossings. Experience ranging from 5 to 10 years in a relevant heavy equipment operating role. Skills in machine inspection and operator-level maintenance, with disciplined defect reporting and daily log keeping. Ability to assess ground conditions, gradient, and trench-edge proximity, and to work safely alongside adjacent machines and crews. Ability to receive and confirm hand and radio signals, and to understand permit and lift-plan briefings. Functional English or Arabic is required for safety communication. Commitment to stop-work authority, exclusion zone discipline, and full PPE compliance at all times. Willingness to work extended shifts, six days per week, on a camp-based rotation in remote right-of-way locations. Preferred Qualifications Cross-country transmission pipeline experience on large diameter (24 inch and above) projects is highly desirable. Prior work on Saudi Aramco scope with a main contractor is highly desirable. Aramco-approved operators are preferred. Work Environment This is an on-site, full-time position based in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, requiring work in remote right-of-way locations. The role involves extended shifts and a six-day work week, often within a camp-based rotation. Application Information The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

12429eacb7c4ffed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة أو جدة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تسويق خدمات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار، واستقطاب العملاء، وإعداد العروض، ومتابعة العقود والحجوزات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف من الوظيفة يركز أخصائي التسويق على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء لتحقيق مستهدفات المبيعات وتعزيز الإيرادات. يشمل ذلك تطوير استراتيجيات تسويقية فعالة لخدمات النقل، وتحليل السوق، وضمان رضا العملاء من خلال عروض تنافسية وخدمة ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الأهداف والخطط التسويقية لخدمات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين. تحليل أسعار المنافسين لتطوير سياسات وباقات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد البرامج الترويجية واختيار أفضل القنوات للتسويق. بناء وتوطيد العلاقات مع شركات ومؤسسات الحج والعمرة ووكالات السفر. وضع جدول زمني لتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الخاصة بمواسم الحج والعمرة. متابعة أداء الحملات التسويقية لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المستهدفة. تقييم واختبار مسارات وباقات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين الجديدة قبل طرحها رسمياً، باستخدام البرامج والأنظمة الرقمية المعتمدة. إعداد تقارير الأداء التسويقي والعلاقات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول لتطوير الخدمات الميدانية. حفظ البيانات وفق السياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التسويق، ويفضل أن يكون ذلك في قطاع النقل أو السياحة الدينية. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص التسويقية. مهارات قوية في بناء العلاقات والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على إعداد العروض التقديمية والتفاوض على العقود. إتقان استخدام البرامج والأنظمة الرقمية ذات الصلة بالتسويق. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة أو جدة. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تعزيز مكانة الشركة في سوق نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

1247803c3833a822.description: About the Role Edwards Lifesciences is seeking a Director, Sales TMTT EEMEA to lead the Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business across the EEMEA region, encompassing both direct and distributor markets. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires over 10 years of experience. The Director will be responsible for accelerating sustainable growth, expanding therapy adoption, and leading innovation launches within the Structural Heart sector. The Director will work to achieve commercial, operational, and patient-impact objectives, while strengthening Edwards Lifesciences’ leadership position in the market. Key Responsibilities Drive the expansion and scaling of the TMTT business across EEMEA by identifying growth opportunities and developing sustainable market infrastructure. Lead the introduction, launch, and adoption of current and future TMTT innovations in collaboration with Global and European Business Units and other functions. Develop and execute strategies to expand patient access to advanced mitral and tricuspid therapies through stakeholder engagement and reimbursement initiatives. 12c1273f28d4c489.description: Design the Vision. Deliver the Detail. The most rewarding spaces are the ones you help bring to life, not just the ones you imagine. If you combine a designer’s creativity with the technical precision to see a project through on-site, this opportunity puts both strengths to work. Our client, a growing luxury interior design and construction company in Riyadh, is seeking an Interior Design Engineer to turn client ambitions into thoughtfully designed, carefully executed interiors. A compelling concept is only the beginning. The real achievement is preserving its character through every drawing, material selection, and finishing detail. In this role, you’ll connect creative direction with practical delivery. Working closely with clients, design teams, contractors, and suppliers, you’ll help ensure that finished spaces reflect the approved vision while meeting functional requirements and project timelines. For a hands-on designer, this is an opportunity to stay involved where your decisions matter: from the first client conversation to the final site inspection. About Our Client Our client specialises in luxury interior design and construction execution for corporate and private clients. Based in Riyadh, the company manages projects across the full lifecycle, bringing together concept development, design, project management, and on-site delivery.Its work requires more than visual appeal. Every project calls for an understanding of how a space should look, function, and be built. You’ll contribute to the full process, working where design intent meets materials, craftsmanship, and client expectations. What You’ll Own You’ll take an active role across the design and execution journey, with responsibilities that extend beyond the drawing board. Translate client ambitions into a clear design direction. Develop mood boards, color schemes, and material palettes that balance aesthetic preferences with the practical needs of each space. Create photorealistic visualizations using 3ds Max with V-Ray or Corona to help clients understand and confidently approve the concept. Turn approved concepts into buildable details. Produce accurate Revit and AutoCAD execution drawings, architectural layouts, joinery details, and finishing specifications that give execution teams clear guidance. Bring the right materials into the finished space. Source and evaluate materials, select and approve samples, coordinate with suppliers, negotiate terms, and manage delivery schedules to support project progress. Protect design quality on-site. Conduct regular visits during finishing stages, review work against approved drawings, and collaborate with contractors to resolve discrepancies and practical challenges. Keep clients informed and projects moving. Lead design presentations, explain recommendations clearly, communicate progress, and address design questions as they arise throughout execution. What Makes You Successful You’re a designer who cares as much about how a space is built as how it looks. You can move confidently between creative exploration, technical documentation, and on-site problem-solving without losing sight of the client’s priorities. You hold a bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or Architectural Engineering, supported by proven experience in both concept development and on-site finishing supervision. Your technical capabilities include strong proficiency in 3ds Max, Revit, AutoCAD, and Photoshop, alongside a sound understanding of materials, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), joinery, and interior construction details. Additional skills in SketchUp, Lumion, or V-Ray are an advantage. You understand the Saudi design, construction, events, and luxury projects market. Just as importantly, you communicate effectively, handle client requirements thoughtfully, and coordinate multiple projects under tight deadlines. Your portfolio should tell the complete project story: initial concepts, 3D renders, execution drawings, and photographs of completed spaces. What’s In It for You This opportunity brings together the creative and technical sides of interior design in one role. You’ll work on luxury interiors, engage directly with clients, and stay connected to the execution of your designs rather than handing them off at the visualisation stage. The breadth of the work offers practical opportunities to deepen your expertise in material selection, supplier coordination, construction detailing, and site supervision while contributing to a growing business in Riyadh. Bring Your Best Work to Life If you’re ready to take your designs from concept to completed space, we’d like to see what you can create and deliver. Apply with your CV and portfolio, showcasing the projects you’ve helped shape from the first idea to the final finish.

1280d72b19c972df.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيان كابيتال عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد المخاطر، وتوفير المعدات اللازمة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى إعداد وتطوير الأسس والقواعد والإجراءات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل. كما يشمل الدور تحديد الأخطار المهنية المحتملة ووضع الإجراءات الوقائية لتفاديها، بالإضافة إلى توفير مستلزمات وأدوات السلامة ومتابعة استخدامها بفعالية. ويعد إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة جزءًا أساسيًا من مهام الدور. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، مثل سياسات السلامة، تعليمات العمل الآمن، تعليمات الإخلاء، تعليمات لجان السلامة، سجلات السلامة، والفحص الطبي، ومتابعة اعتمادها وضمان الالتزام بها. تحديد مكامن الأخطار الميكانيكية والكهربائية والكيميائية في موقع العمل، ووضع الإشارات والملصقات التحذيرية المناسبة. إعداد قوائم بنود وكميات ومواصفات معدات ومستلزمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، ومتابعة توفيرها وضمان التزام العاملين باستخدامها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير السياسات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالسلامة. معرفة قوية بتحديد وتقييم المخاطر المهنية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى معايير السلامة في بيئة العمل. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

12985a603b39a444.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 We are hiring a Pay Expansion Executive who will specialize in POS/cash management within Foodics, focusing on the “existing” customer base and increasing the adoption of Foodics Pay through various products. You will work closely with internal cross-functional teams such as Customer Success, Operations, and Sales teams, and will be on top of opportunities generated from the existing customer base or creating your own opportunities to grow your customer portfolio, identifying wins that add value to the customer and Foodics. The ideal candidate will have solid skills in sales, account management, and product knowledge. And has a technical background to help navigate all sales and deliver the solutions that the customers need ensuring successful outcomes and growth. What Will You Do❓ Responsible for selling of the Foodics Pay products to our clients. Building a pipeline with opportunities that is always active with a strong closing rate. Maintaining solid relationships with customers and delivering great outcomes with a high value to the customer, ensuring growth and revenue generation. Closing “pre-generated” opportunities from cross-functional teams and consulting with the customer on potential cross-sell and up-sell opportunities. Understand the market landscape and align with customers on market trends and direction and how to maintain a competitive advantage at all times. Engaging with customers, demonstrating and showcasing our products. Holding Demos with potential customers and ensuring utilization. Reporting closed wins, and closed lost and enhancing the process to deliver better results. Reporting and communicating on a periodic basis with the Sales Expansion Team Leader on process optimization, offers, bundling, and customer feedback to enhance the process overall and maintain better results. Calling customers, scheduling meetings, and remaining on top of customer’s needs. What Are We Looking For❓ Preferably Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or relevant studies. 2-3 years of work experience in a relevant field. Prior proven track record in sales, pipeline, and funnel management, managing an entire sales cycle and ensuring full-service delivery. High agility and able to cope in a fast-paced work environment. Building strong, trusting relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Ownership, analytical mindset, self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit. Team player and previously worked with cross-functional teams. Must have solid English & Arabic communication skills. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Must have a valid driving license & own a car. Should be familiar with the different cities of the country he/she is assigned to. Willing to do field work and travel from time to time (within and outside the area that you will be assigned). Passion for technology and for being a part of a fast-growing SaaS company. Passion for Food and Restaurants. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

1245bfd3c7d22f90.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The role will be responsible for the full order lifecycle — from receiving and processing orders to fulfillment, shipping, delivery, inventory coordination, and resolving operational issues. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Monitor marketplace cancellations, returns, delayed orders, and fulfillment issues. Coordinate inventory availability across the website and marketplaces. Identify and resolve operational issues that may negatively impact marketplace performance. Coordinate issues related to SKUs, barcodes, product mapping, and inventory synchronization . Inventory & Branch Coordination Monitor inventory availability across the e-commerce store and marketplaces. Coordinate with the warehouse and branches to ensure stock availability. Manage and follow up on stock transfers and replenishment between the warehouse and branches . Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock items and escalate when replenishment is required. Identify and resolve discrepancies between physical and system inventory. Ensure accurate SKU and barcode mapping across all sales channels. Shipping & Logistics Operations Manage daily operational coordination with courier and logistics partners. Ensure orders are assigned to the appropriate shipping provider. Monitor AWB creation, shipment pickup, delivery, and shipment status . Follow up on delayed, failed, or returned shipments. Coordinate with couriers, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve delivery issues. Monitor recurring shipping problems and escalate them when required. Operations Control & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely order status updates across all systems and marketplaces. Conduct daily follow-ups on pending, delayed, and exception orders. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce Operations, Marketplace Operations, Order Fulfillment, or a similar role. Hands-on experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, and logistics operations. Experience with Zid is highly preferred. Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplaces is preferred. Good understanding of Order Fulfillment, Inventory Management, and Marketplace Operations . Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency

The MDM Administration Analyst will work closely with various stakeholders to facilitate data entry, maintenance, and retrieval, while also providing analysis and reporting on master data issues. You will be key in developing and enforcing MDM policies and procedures to streamline master data management practices across the organization. If selected, the work location would be onsite at Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Implement solutions developed for issues related to physical servers, virtual servers, and data storage centres. Contact vendors to obtain proposals, evaluate proposal, and prepare reports on technical feasibility to support the selection process. Conduct installation, configuration, and operation of new systems. Monitor the operation of the systems, and carry out the necessary maintenance for the systems and the backup systems. Create email accounts for non-automated process including contractor and staff emails. Add users, deletes users, creates groups, and disables account on separation. Search solutions for internet security, antivirus’ software, and firewalls. Prepares technical reports to support management with selecting the right data solutions. Configure firewalls, implement the system polices and password policy, update antiviruses to ensure that user data is protected.
